text:
deploy-bot: initiating canary rollout release/gale-7 -> traffic=7% ap-southeast-1. autopage rule: page-on-5xx>1.5% for 3m

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-9001 triggered: "ap-southeast-1 canary 5xx surge" urgency: high. on-call: @oncall-lina

oncall-lina: ack PD-9001 :wave: i'm on it, starting triage

sre-omar: seeing rapid spike in 5xx from canary pods; logs show tokenizer OOM during batch tokenization. p95 latency ballooning.

eng-meera: any stack or sample logs? pinging token team.

sre-omar: paste snippet
```
2026-03-18T22:04:12Z tokenizer: alloc failed: requested 1073741824 bytes
runtime: out of memory
rpc: error: code = Unknown desc = "upstream closed"
```

infra-sam: host metrics show mem rss growth across iter. 2 nodes at >90% mem. kernel oom-killer not yet invoked.

eng-meera: this is the new tokenizer-cache change from PR #2100. @eng-meera assigning to me. suggest immediate traffic divert and kill canary replicas.

oncall-lina: CS aware? @cs-julia

cs-julia: got two customer reports of "partial failures" for embeddings and batch-infer. marking P2, referencing PD-9001.

deploy-bot: traffic-diversion: setting release/gale-7 traffic=0% for ap-southeast-1 -> reroute to release/gale-stable

pagerduty-bot: PD-9001 update: acknowledged by oncall-lina. escalation timer paused.

sre-omar: after divert, 5xx rate down to 0.2% in ~60s. But canary pods still show mem growth. recommend rollback and taint nodes.

infra-sam: applying taint:
```
kubectl taint nodes ap-s1-node-77 unschedulable=true:NoSchedule
kubectl taint nodes ap-s1-node-78 unschedulable=true:NoSchedule
```

eng-meera: initiating rollback now, reverting tokenizer-cache change. roll command:
```
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/gale gale=image:gale-stable && kubectl rollout status deploy/gale -n prod
```

oncall-lina: timeline note: page fired 22:04 UTC, divert 22:06, rollback start 22:08, customer tickets 22:09

sre-omar: collecting heap profiles and core dumps to /tmp/PD-9001/artifacts, uploading to eng ticket.

eng-meera: reproduced locally with stress harness and debug flag --token-cache. creating hotfix PR linking PD-9001.

infra-sam: cordons in place; will drain problem nodes after rollback

cs-julia: updating customers: mitigation in place, traffic rerouted, engineers investigating. will send targeted postmortem draft.

deploy-bot: rollback completed, stable image restored. rollout status: success, traffic stable.

sre-omar: metrics: 5xx back to baseline ~0.05% in region; p95 restored. leaving cordons for further forensics.

eng-meera: PR for fix: https://git.company/repo/pulls/2123 - include a fallback path and a mem watchdog.

oncall-lina: i'll resolve PD-9001 after 90m stable metrics. action items: add token-cache mem detector to canary health, add rollback snippet to runbook, run offline postmortem next week.

pagerduty-bot: PD-9001 status changed: acknowledged -> resolved by oncall-lina at 23:45 UTC

cs-julia: will coordinate customer-notice once RCA draft ready. ping me for timelines.

oncall-lina: thanks team. opening rca-gale-7 channel for follow-ups. closing thread.
